rv.q: If it is unfaithful, it is very winning in Talawa and Belgrade Theatre’s exuberant all-Black production, which luxuriates in its musicality and movement.
The spirit of Duke Ellington pulses through a glorious musical spin on Twelfth Night.

cn.t: Critics praise this jazz-infused Twelfth Night adaptation for its sparkling musicality and elegant movement, with Duke Ellington's spirit bringing warmth and glory to Shakespeare's comedy of mistaken identity.
